source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Your **KILL TEAM** units that have this rule gain three abilities tied to their doctrine. **Furor Tactics**: with the **[devastator doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)** active for the unit, its attacks gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**. **Malleus Tactics**: with the **[tactical doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)** active, its attacks gain **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**. **Purgatus Tactics**: with the **[assault doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)** active, its attacks gain **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** against enemy units no more than 9" away from it. **DEATHWATCH ALLIES**: your army may include **DEATHWATCH** units even though their Chapter keyword differs, as long as they total no more than 500 points; this is an exception to **Space Marine Chapters Army Rules**. Unless something says otherwise, no DEATHWATCH model may be your **WARLORD**, and KILL TEAM units may only take Enhancements from this detachment.
